title: Two-term small-time spectral expansions for controllability Gramians
summary: For a controllable single-input linear system in dimension $n$, the controllability Gramian eigenvalues, ordered decreasingly, are known to have the successive small-time orders $T, T^3, \ldots, T^{2n-1}$. We refine this leading-order hierarchy by explicitly computing the next-order coefficient of every eigenvalue and the first-order variation of its eigendirection and of the nested spectral subspaces.
